name: Chicago Police and Firefighter Training Academy (CPFTA)
org: Chicago Public Schools with Chicago Police, Fire and City Colleges
what_you_do: This two-year after-school program is for juniors and seniors. You apply as a sophomore. Classes meet twice a week at the Police or Fire Academy. Qualified students can earn OSHA, CPR and EMT-B certifications. It leads to a path into City Colleges.
grades: Apply in 10th grade; program runs 11th and 12th grade
who_can_apply: Sophomores who live in Chicago and attend a Chicago high school (public, private or homeschooled). A 2.3 GPA and 90% attendance are recommended. Needs 2 recommendation letters, a physical and a background check.
pay_detail: Free: uniforms, materials, snacks and transportation help provided; scholarships possible. A paid summer internship between junior and senior year is possible (pay not stated).
duration: Two years; Tuesday and Wednesday 4:30 to 7:30 p.m., September to May
deadline_text: The application for the class of 2028 is closed. Sophomores apply online each year beginning in February; recruitment events run in February and March. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Complete the online application, a signed consent form, a copy of a school or state ID, 2 recommendation letters, a physical exam record and a background check.
notes: Takes up to 125 students each year. Contact: cpfta@cps.edu or 773-553-2486.
